creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the early-blocked fix (04f7d15f, 2026-10-21). Run logs show Claude Code's and Codex's PermissionRequest hook firing 2-4 s before any dialog is drawn, and often for approvals nobody is asked (auto mode, or an approval the harness settles itself). The fix waits for a still screen rather than trusting the hook, but what the harness does in that window is not recorded. Record it for the current Claude Code in docs/observations/claude-code-<version>.md, with a transcript in corpus/, and say whether PermissionRequest fires for approvals nobody sees.
title: Record what Claude Code does between PermissionRequest and drawing its dialog
